webReferences.name: The Guide to Almost All Missile Functions
webReferences.author: Cypress
webReferences.upstreamTarget: Diablo II Legacy and early D2R missile and missile-skill function behavior
scope: missiles.txt client, server, hit and damage function behavior
skills.txt missile-function recipes and parameter interactions
missile creation, movement, collision and damage experiments
practical missile-function compatibility and test cases
threadNotes: The guide is a broad empirical map of the D2R 2.4-era function ranges, but D2R 3.2 adds later skill and missile function families and changes several table fields; use the current d2rdoc definitions for the active catalog.

The GargoyleTrap entry labels function 93 as srvstfunc even though the inspected D2R 3.2 row uses srvdofunc 93, and the PrimePoisonNova entry labels function 99 as cltstfunc even though the current row uses srvdofunc 99 with cltdofunc 55.
A 2026 follow-up identifies TowerChestSpawner CltParam3 as the chest-object search radius, replacing the main guide's unknown marker.

A 2026 follow-up warns that the exploding-javelin and ice-javelin splash approach does not inherit the expected damage-percent bonus scaling, and later replies document DamageBlessedHammer interactions absent from the main guide.
webReferences.provenance: community-authored empirical guide with credited prior sources
policy: Use the guide as a recipe catalog and as candidate test cases for missile-function behavior, not as the current D2R 3.2 function registry.
Treat eezstreet d2rdoc and the exact target skills.txt and missiles.txt tables as authoritative for current codes, fields and row identities.
Reproduce damage scaling, collision, client-server synchronization and multiplayer-sensitive behavior against the targeted installed D2R build before implementation.

webReferences.name: The Guide to Almost All Non-Missile Skill Functions
webReferences.author: Cypress
webReferences.upstreamTarget: Diablo II Legacy and partial D2R non-missile skill-function behavior
scope: skills.txt attack, spell, state, pet and summon function behavior
sequence, aura, charge-up and finishing-move interactions
client-server function combinations and synchronization caveats
skill rows reported as hardcoded by original ID
threadNotes: The edited guide is primarily a Legacy empirical reference with sparse D2R annotations; its explicit function coverage stops before the D2R 3.2 additions documented by the current d2rdoc skill-function tables.
The hardcoded-ID listing assigns Left Hand Throw to ID 3 and Nest to ID 169, while the inspected vanilla 2.4, vanilla 3.2 and BKVince tables place them at IDs 4 and 167 respectively.

The guide says Inner Sight srvdofunc 6 applies only aurastat1, while the current d2rdoc description permits all aura stats and a 2025 D2R follow-up reports aurastat2 through aurastat6 working in Resurrected.

The Hydra entry combines Legacy assumptions and later corrections about calc1, ln12, duration, bonus life and pet skill inheritance; 2025 and 2026 follow-ups add D2R-specific and pet-summoning observations that were not folded into the older edited sections.

During the 2026-07-31 audit, BKVince placed Concentration at row ID 108 and Blessed Aim at row ID 113, inherited from BK, BT and TCP. If the guide's reported Aura Enchanted hardcoding to skill ID 108 persists in build 92777, the visible result would differ from vanilla; that remains an unproved native and runtime hypothesis.
webReferences.provenance: community-authored empirical guide with credited prior sources
policy: Use the guide as a practical recipe catalog and as candidate test cases for skill, sequence, aura, pet and summon behavior.
Treat eezstreet d2rdoc and the exact target skills.txt table as authoritative for current function codes, parameter fields and skill row identities.
Distinguish Legacy, D2R, single-player and multiplayer observations, and reproduce client-server-sensitive behavior on the targeted installed build before implementation.
Treat every reported hardcoded skill ID as a reverse-engineering lead until independently proved in the D2R 3.2.92777 workbench or by a controlled runtime test.
Do not use this guide as evidence for a D2R build, RVA, signature, structure layout, ABI or unchanged native handler.
